title: BAB Online socket contract
$comment: GENERATED by npm run contract:gen from contract/src. Wire changes are additive only until the v1 removals (contract/V1_REMOVALS.md).

inMs.description: ms the server still holds the table, from serverTime (relative: never compare with a client clock)

clientHello.notes: Sent on every connect by clients that read avatarUrl / avatarUrls ($defs.clientCap). No reply. Absent = legacy shape (the App Store iOS build, cached old web bundles). Unknown caps are ignored; the last hello wins (one without avatarUrl downgrades the socket). Over the rate limit it is dropped silently. Logged with the client version (telemetry for V1_REMOVALS).

joinQueue.notes: Registered with safeHandler (no Joi, no rate limit). V1_REMOVALS #2.

addBot.notes: The handler ignores the payload; iOS sends {personality}.

removeBot.notes: iOS LobbyEmitter.removeBot sends no payload (the server answers error). No Joi schema yet.

playerBid.notes: Web sends a string; iOS an Int for numeric bids and a string for bores.

requestSnapshot.notes: New in snapshot v2 (no shipped iOS client sends it yet). Answered by stateSnapshot to this socket only. Web always sends {requestId, customPics:false, log:false}: "ping-*" its liveness ping after the tab was hidden > 5 s (item 15; a reconnect only when no reply arrives), "gap-*" on a seq gap (debounced: one in flight), "ack-*" when its bid/play got no answer for 5 s (item 16); every reply with a snapshot of its table is applied and rendered.

uploadProfilePic.notes: Pipeline on (docs/avatars.md): decoded and re-encoded server-side; stored as a WebP data URL <= 256 px; undecodable or unsafe images are refused with the usual {success:false, message}.

getLeaderboard.notes: Throttled in-handler (rateLimiter key getLeaderboard); over the limit replies leaderboardResponse with the cached (possibly stale) result, else the fill in flight, else the existing {success:false, message} reply; never error. Served from a 60 s cache invalidated on stats/picture/account changes.

getRecords.notes: Throttled in-handler (rateLimiter key getRecords); over the limit replies recordsResponse with the cached (possibly stale) result, else the fill in flight, else the existing {success:false, message} reply; never error. Served from a 60 s cache (per month) invalidated when a game is recorded or an account deleted.

searchPlayers.notes: asyncHandler("searchPlayers") but validators has no schema: passes through with a warning. A trimmed query longer than 50 (the username max) short-circuits to an empty list in the handler.

getPlayerProfile.notes: No Joi schema yet (passes through with a warning).

activeGameFound.notes: Never emitted (signInResponse.activeGameId replaced it). CAUTION: the only event that makes the shipped iOS app emit rejoinGame by itself (AuthSocketHandler.handleActiveGameFound); see V1_REMOVALS.md.

mainRoomJoined.notes: recentMessages duplicates messages (iOS reads recentMessages first).

mainRoomPlayerJoined.notes: socket.to(mainRoom): everyone in the main room but the joiner.

mainRoomPlayerLeft.notes: New: the user's last socket disconnected (the online list shrank). Counterpart of mainRoomPlayerJoined. A sign-out that keeps the socket open is not covered. Current builds ignore it and keep a stale count (ctr-21).

lobbiesUpdated.notes: getLobbies answers the requesting socket with the same shape.

lobbyCreated.notes: withoutName only from the unsent joinQueue path.

lobbyJoined.notes: Never emitted: joining a lobby answers lobbyCreated.

lobbyMessage.notes: Sent to every lobby member, bots included (bot: ids never reach a wire).

queueUpdate.notes: Only from the unsent leaveQueue; no listener in either client. V1_REMOVALS #2.

iOS would read it as a seat before seats exist

youDrew.notes: The watchdog variant goes through game.sendToPlayer (io.to(socketId)).

reserved.why: iOS DrawResult reads cardIndex (defaults to 0 today)

playerAssigned.notes: Web main.js reads it; replaced by v2 viewer.position (V1_REMOVALS #7).

resumeInMs.description: TEAMS_MS: the server holds the announcement this long before createUI/gameStart

teamsAnnounced.notes: resumeInMs (additive, relative; contract/README.md "Resume holds"): web sizes its fade to it; the shipped iOS app ignores it.

positionUpdate.notes: pics: the legacy value for every recipient (one room broadcast): number, null, or for a custom picture the small derived inline WebP data URL (docs/avatars.md). avatarUrls (additive, only when a rendition exists): {position: /avatar URL}, preferred by capable clients; the shipped iOS app and old web ignore it.

reserved.why: iOS reads yourPosition as the viewer seat

gameStart.notes: One per connected seat owner (seat) and per spectator (spectator), each deal. players: seat socket ids, read by web as playerData.socket to map a voice peer to a seat (the speaking indicator; V1_REMOVALS #6). playerInfo rebuilds web avatars every hand (V1_REMOVALS #5).

reserved.why: deferred: the shipped iOS app resets mults only in reset(), so a bore badge would persist into the next deal (V1_REMOVALS.md "Deferred additive")
deferred: same as team1Mult

bidReceived.notes: bid echoes the client value: an Int from iOS numeric bids (bidWire; V1_REMOVALS #11).

doneBidding.notes: Web reads bids and lead; iOS reads lead. teamBids (capped at the hand size) and mults (bore multipliers) are additive and read by neither shipped client. Not sent for an all-zero redeal.

reserved.why: iOS reads currentTurn ?? turn

updateTurn.notes: private: goActive re-sends it to the returning owner socket only.

resumeInMs.description: Only on the card that completes a trick: TRICK_VIEW_MS until trickComplete

cardPlayed.notes: resumeInMs (additive, relative; contract/README.md "Resume holds") only on the 4th card of a trick; built by GameState.cardPlayedPayload for both emit sites.

reserved.why: iOS reads trumpBroken ?? trump; trump must stay a Bool

actionRejected.notes: iOS reads action == "play" (rollbackCardPlay); web (item 16) rolls its pending bid/play back (state/MyAction.js) and renders the snapshot (the card returns to the hand; partial log: the log is kept). Always BEFORE the restorePlayerState of a "Card not in hand" play.

resumeInMs.description: Only on the last trick of a hand: HAND_END_MS (GAME_END_MS on hand 13) until handComplete

trickComplete.notes: Absent resumeInMs: the next trick is open now (updateTurn follows in the same tick).

restorePlayerState.notes: After actionRejected on a "Card not in hand" play (#183), and on /active from the watch view.

stateSnapshot.notes: New in snapshot v2: the reply to requestSnapshot. The log is included unless the request sends log:false; custom (data-URL) seat pictures only with customPics:true (partial lists what was left out). notInGame: the socket is in no live game - also once its game ENDED or ABORTED (the terminal state arrives as gameEnd / abortGame, never as a snapshot).

rejoinFailed.notes: Web drops its game on ANY rejoinFailed.

playerDisconnected.notes: private: the replay to a returning socket.

playerActiveMode.notes: One room broadcast: pic is the legacy value (the small inline WebP for a custom picture); avatarUrl (additive, only with a rendition) is preferred by capable clients.

reserved.why: notice only: both clients route a payload with players + trump as the full state

spectatorJoined.notes: fullState goes to the joining socket only (socket.emit), BEFORE the room notice. The notice reaches the joiner too (ctr-17; V1_REMOVALS #8). trumpBroken / teamTricks / oppTricks switch on reads the App Store iOS build already has in restoreFromSpectator (since Feb 2026): its spectator view CHANGES visibly, knowingly, as a fix (real trump-broken state and trick counts instead of false and 0-0). leadPosition is read only by iOS source builds after 10d1538 (the App Store build infers the lead from the first card). ctr-1, ctr-8, ios-8d; web reads none of them.

leaderboardResponse.notes: Rows by recipient (docs/avatars.md): a capable socket gets customProfilePic null + avatarUrls {username: url}; a legacy one the small inline rendition. The App Store iOS build reads neither.

tournamentPlayerLeft.notes: username is absent when the leaver had no registered user (user?.username).

voiceOffer.notes: username is the server-side name of the sender; absent if the sender is not signed in.

voicePeerLeft.notes: room: a game seat owner dropped (game.broadcast); private: lobby peers (io.to(socketId)).

serverShutdown.notes: No listener in either client today (V1_REMOVALS #17).

error.notes: App-level event (not the transport's error). iOS receives it through Socket.IO-Client-Swift's clientEvent .error (the reserved name) and, since 0fd6ef1, shows message as a toast. variant validation is dead today (validators.withValidation has no caller). Rename to serverError is V1_REMOVALS #1.
